_comment: Delegations the founder gave in his own words. Each covers nothing until its decision record is accepted (scripts/lib/autonomy.ts evaluateDelegation). memory-fabric is never delegated. A delegated approval is recorded under minspec-sdd[bot], never the founder. See DR-108.

delegations.words: the specs are well defined enough thus far, so i'm happy to greenlight all future development, provided you keep that ratio in mind.
delegations.source: Founder to his chief-of-staff session, queue item in5 (the operator task queue, outside this repo). The ratio is 333Method's 3:1 bugfixes to functionality.

Founder's reply to queue item cg1112 (the operator task queue, outside this repo), choosing option g: agents may select the recommended answer to a T3 spec's Clarify items, recorded under the bot's own name, SPEC-217, SPEC-227 and every T4 spec excepted. His reply was the single key quoted in words; the option's full text is not recorded in this repo. Inert until DR-122 is accepted; the exclusions are enforced in scripts/lib/autonomy.ts clarifySelectionRefusal, not by this entry.
